_comment: Origin-source registry for INH Verified. manufacturer_domains are the only hosts a 'manufacturer' or 'manufacturer_manual' source_url may name for that brand. distributors stays EMPTY until the user approves an allow-list (data/verified/distributors-proposed.json). Retailers, including inhousewellness.com, are never sources.

Golden Designs Inc.pdf_note: Manuals linked from Golden Designs' own product descriptions live on its Azure storage account. That host's robots.txt returns 4xx, so linked files are fetched under the B1-D2 policy (CLAUDE.md, source policy).

Salus Saunas.pdf_hosts_note: Salus's own Shopify file store: the path prefix /s/files/1/0720/7695/1854/ is shop 72076951854, the id in Salus's robots.txt.

Maxxus.status_note: Golden Designs' own catalogue sells this brand under vendor 'Golden Designs Inc (NA)', and its About page says it 'work[s] directly with manufacturers to produce our own line', but no Golden Designs page names this brand as its own. Whether goldendesigninc.com is this brand's MANUFACTURER source or an unapproved distributor is decision B2-D1. Until then: computed, never published.

blocked_domains.dynamicsaunas.com: TLS: self-signed certificate. Certificate checks are never bypassed.
